title: AI Data Centers Are Quietly Running on Natural Gas and These 3 ETFs Own the Whole Supply Chain
excerpt: AI data centers are quietly reshaping demand for natural gas, and three ETFs cover every piece of that supply chain from the wellhead to the power plant. Kno...
content_html:
David Beren

Sun, August 2, 2026 at 9:45 AM EDT 6 min read

Quick Read

  • FCG captures upstream producers up 19% year to date while MLPX's toll-road pipeline fees have delivered 25% YTD and 173% over five years.

  • AMLP pays a 7% yield with quarterly distributions climbing to $1.03, offering concentrated income exposure to AI-driven natural gas pipeline volume growth.

  • Gas-fired plants can be sited next to data centers in two years, making natural gas the fastest dispatchable answer to AI's surging power demand.

  • Don't wait: the analyst who called NVIDIA in 2010 just revealed his top 10 AI stocks. See the full list FREE now.

Data center construction across the United States is running headfirst into a power supply problem, and natural gas is emerging as the fastest available answer. Hyperscalers building AI training clusters need firm, dispatchable megawatts, and the U.S. Department of Energy projects data centers will account for up to 12% of U.S. electrical demand by 2028. That has drawn attention to three exchange-traded funds that map the natural gas supply chain from wellhead to power plant: First Trust Natural Gas ETF (NYSEARCA:FCG) on the upstream side, Global X MLP & Energy Infrastructure ETF (NYSEARCA:MLPX) covering hybrid midstream, and Alerian MLP ETF (NYSEARCA:AMLP) for pure master limited partnership exposure.

Each fund captures a different segment of the same trade. FCG owns the producers extracting gas, while MLPX and AMLP own the pipelines and processing plants that move it. Henry Hub spot prices are sitting in the $2.73 to $3.34 range in July, well below the $30.72 spike hit on January 23, 2026 during winter storms, which frames the current entry point for anyone playing this theme.

Don't wait: the analyst who called NVIDIA in 2010 just revealed his top 10 AI stocks. See the full list FREE now.

Why Gas Is Winning the Data Center Power Race

Gas-fired combined-cycle plants can be sited in roughly two years next to a data center campus, offering the around-the-clock reliability AI workloads require on a faster build timeline than new nuclear capacity, which takes a decade to permit and construct. The EIA's May outlook forecasts the Henry Hub price to average about $3.50/MMBtu in 2026 and $3.18/MMBtu in 2027, and projects power sector gas consumption to climb from 35.2 Bcf/d in 2025 to between 38.1 and 50.4 Bcf/d by 2050. LNG export capacity is also expanding, with U.S. terminals adding roughly 0.9 Bcf/d of export capacity in April.

FCG: The Upstream Producer Trade

U.S. natural gas exploration and production companies are what FCG holds, giving it the most direct commodity price leverage of the three funds. When gas prices rise, the earnings sensitivity of E&P names tends to be greater than that of fee-based midstream operators. According to the fund's disclosures, FCG manages $648.60 million in assets with an expense ratio of 0.99%, and its top holdings include Western Midstream Partners at 4.89%, Hess Midstream at 4.72%, and ConocoPhillips at 4.28%.

美国各地的数据中心建设首先遇到了电力供应问题，而天然气正在成为最快的解决方案。 构建人工智能训练集群的超大规模企业需要稳定、可调度的兆瓦电力，美国能源部预计，到 2028 年，数据中心将占美国电力需求的 12%。 这引起了人们对绘制从井口到发电厂的天然气供应链的三只交易所交易基金的关注：上游的 First Trust Natural Gas ETF (NYSEARCA:FCG)、涵盖混合中游的 Global X MLP & Energy Infrastructure ETF (NYSEARCA:MLPX) 以及纯粹主有限合伙企业的 Alerian MLP ETF (NYSEARCA:AMLP)。

每只基金都涵盖同一交易的不同部分。 FCG 拥有开采天然气的生产商，而 MLPX 和 AMLP 拥有运输天然气的管道和加工厂。 7 月份 Henry Hub 现货价格介于 2.73 美元至 3.34 美元之间，远低于 2026 年 1 月 23 日冬季风暴期间达到的 30.72 美元峰值，这为任何参与该主题的人提供了当前的切入点。

为什么天然气在数据中心电力竞赛中获胜

燃气联合循环发电厂可以在大约两年内建在数据中心园区旁边，提供人工智能工作负载所需的全天候可靠性，其建设时间比新核电厂更快，而新核电厂需要十年的时间才能获得许可和建设。 EIA 5 月份的展望预测，2026 年亨利中心价格平均约为 3.50 美元/MMBtu，2027 年为 3.18 美元/MMBtu，并预计电力行业天然气消耗量将从 2025 年的 35.2 Bcf/d 攀升至 2050 年的 38.1 至 50.4 Bcf/d。 液化天然气出口能力也在扩大，美国终端 4 月份的出口能力增加了约 0.9 Bcf/d。

FCG：上游生产者贸易

FCG持有美国天然气勘探和生产公司，使其拥有三支基金中最直接的大宗商品价格杠杆。 当天然气价格上涨时，勘探与生产公司的盈利敏感性往往高于收费的中游运营商。 根据该基金披露的信息，FCG管理着6.486亿美元的资产，费用率为0.99%，其持股最多的公司包括Western Midstream Partners（4.89%）、Hess Midstream（4.72%）和康菲石油公司（4.28%）。
